shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'vite.config.*' -g 'README*'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,200p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json && cat AGENTS.md && rg -n \"charts|chartkit|Line|Switch|Segmented|Select\" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md src"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '470,520p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && sed -n '1,240p' src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && rg -n \"Button|Select|Segmented|Text|Card\" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && ls -a"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/chartkit @gravity-ui/charts @gravity-ui/yagr'

/bin/bash -lc 'npm view @gravity-ui/chartkit versions --json && npm view @gravity-ui/chartkit@latest peerDependencies && npm view @gravity-ui/charts@1 peerDependencies && npm view @gravity-ui/yagr@latest peerDependencies'

/bin/bash -lc 'npm view @gravity-ui/charts versions --json && npm view @gravity-ui/charts@1.0.0 peerDependencies && npm view @gravity-ui/yagr version peerDependencies && npm view @gravity-ui/chartkit@7.62.1 peerDependencies'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm view @gravity-ui/charts@1.73.0 peerDependencies && npm view @gravity-ui/yagr version peerDependencies && npm view @gravity-ui/chartkit@7.62.1 peerDependencies'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/chartkit@''^7.62.1 @gravity-ui/charts@''^1.73.0 @gravity-ui/yagr'

/bin/bash -lc '.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh chartkit ChartKit && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh charts Chart && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh yagr Yagr && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Text'

/bin/bash -lc 'bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh chartkit ChartKit; bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh charts Chart; bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh yagr Yagr; bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Text'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/docs/INDEX.md && rg -n \"plugin|ChartKit|type|data\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/docs -g '*.md' | head -100 && sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/components/ChartKit.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/index.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/types/index.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/types/widget.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/gravity-charts/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build | rg '(gravity-charts|yagr).*(d\\.ts|md)"'$|plugins/.*/index'"' | head -40 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/INDEX.md && rg -n \"line|Chart|series|axis|tooltip\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs -g '*.md' | head -70 && sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/README.md && sed -n '1,130p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md | head -70"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/gravity-charts/types.d.ts && sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/renderer/YagrWidget.d.ts && rg -n \"timeline|yagr|gravity-charts\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit -g '*.md' -g '*.tsx' | head -70 && sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/series-types/line.md && rg -n \"export.*ChartData|interface ChartData|type ChartData\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/index.d.ts && sed -n '1,200p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/types.d.ts && rg -n \"--g-color-(base|text|line|brand|positive|warning|negative)|--g-spacing\" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -70 && sed -n '1,120p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && cat package.json"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -- '--g-color-(base|text|line|brand)' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -65 && rg -n \"chart.*line|line.*color|color:\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts | head -50 && cat tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"RawSerieData|interface.*Serie|type YagrConfig|interface YagrConfig|export.*YagrConfig\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/types.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist -g '*.d.ts' | head -35 && sed -n '1,50p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '43,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts && sed -n '288,315p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/yagr/dist/YagrCore/types.d.ts && rg -n -- 'base-background|base-generic|text-primary|line-generic|spacing' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/index.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/build/plugins/yagr/index.js && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/package.json | rg -n '\"./yagr\"|\"./gravity-charts\"|\"exports\"'"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- package.json src/main.tsx src/App.tsx | head -220 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/chartkit/package.json | rg -n -C 2 'dependencies|@gravity-ui/charts|@gravity-ui/yagr'"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm uninstall @gravity-ui/charts @gravity-ui/yagr'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'
/bin/bash -lc "python3 -c 'import shutil; shutil.rmtree(\"dist\", ignore_errors=True)' && git status --short && cat package.json"
/bin/bash -lc 'find dist -type f -delete && find dist -depth -type d -empty -delete && git status --short && cat package.json'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"datetime|categories|xAxis\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/axes/axis-types.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts | head -45 && sed -n '1,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/axes/axis-types.md && rg -n \"interface ChartXAxis|type AxisType\" node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'
/bin/bash -lc "find dist -type f -delete && find dist -depth -type d -empty -delete && git diff --stat && git status --short && nl -ba src/App.tsx | sed -n '1,220p' | tail -20"
